title: Request Validation
description: Learn how to validate incoming requests with Zod so your APIs only accept safe, well-formed data and return helpful errors when they do not.

data.text: Every API endpoint should treat its input as untrusted. Request validation is the practice of checking that incoming data matches the shape, type, and rules your endpoint expects before you use it.

Without validation, a missing field, a wrong type, or an extra long string can crash your database query or bypass business rules. Validation catches these problems early and returns a clear message to the client.

items: Prevent database errors from bad input
Return clear error messages instead of 500 crashes
Document your API contract in code
Catch type mismatches before they reach your logic

data.text: Zod is a TypeScript-first schema library. You describe the shape of your data once, and Zod infers the TypeScript type while also validating runtime values. This makes it a natural fit for API request bodies.

data.title: Zod schema for a create-post request

data.text: The `createPostInput` type is now guaranteed to match the schema. You can import it in your Route Handler and feel confident about the data shape.
Parse the request body with `createPostSchema.parse()` inside your `POST` handler. If the data is invalid, Zod throws an error you can catch and format into a useful response.

data.title: Validating a POST body in a Route Handler
Reuse Schemas Across the Stack
data.text: Define validators in a shared `lib/validators/` folder and import them in Route Handlers, server components, and client forms. This keeps your API contract consistent end to end.
Query parameters are always strings. When validating them, coerce values to the right type and provide sensible defaults for optional filters.

data.title: Validating search query params
Key Takeaways
items: Always validate incoming data before using it in queries or mutations
Zod gives you runtime validation and TypeScript types from one schema
Return 400 with structured error details when validation fails
Share validators between client forms and server handlers
